_comment: Curated corrections to sheet "1. Ingredients" of the v6 workbook, keyed by source_ref and merged into the generated rows by scripts/convert-v6-workbook.py. Only `default_unit_code` is merged today, and only where an entry states one; everything else a row carries still comes from the sheet. This is an input to the conversion rather than an output of it, in the same way packaging-overlay.json is. The workbook itself is not in this repository, so the same change has ALSO been applied by hand to the committed platform-ingredients.json — the overlay is what makes it survive the next regeneration, not what produced the committed row.

items.note: Eggs are counted, not weighed: every technical sheet states them in pieces. The workbook leaves the Unit column blank, so the generator defaulted the row to kg and a line reading "4 piece" could not be costed or weighed. The mass of one piece is supplied separately, by scripts/convert-nutrition-table.py.
